question: Who among the following received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to tribal dance Baiga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjun Singh Dhurwey**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** is one of India's most prestigious honors for individuals who have made significant contributions to the performing arts, including music, dance, drama, folk arts, and traditional forms.
 
• **Arjun Singh Dhurwey** is a prominent exponent of **Baiga dance**, a traditional tribal dance form performed by the **Baiga tribe** of Central India, particularly in Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh.
 
• Baiga dance is deeply rooted in the tribal community's cultural and religious traditions. It is performed during festivals, rituals, and community celebrations, showcasing their connection to nature and spirituality.
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurwey has been instrumental in preserving and popularizing this tribal dance form, which is an integral part of India's rich intangible cultural heritage.
 
• His dedication to keeping the tradition alive and his contribution to the broader recognition of tribal art forms earned him the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hem Chandra Goswami** is known for his contributions to Sattriya dance.
 
• **Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan** is recognized for his work in Sattriya dance as well.
 
• **Som Datt Battu** is known for his contributions to folk music, not tribal dance.
